description.value:
Some scouts prefer to slip past an enemy's defenses; followers of the Artillerist Technique would rather smash straight through them. They've learned to hold a tech power's energy in check, unleashing it a heartbeat later than expected and layering in devastating side effects that catch even prepared foes off guard.

Precise timing is their signature. Powers detonate exactly where they intend, punishing anyone careless enough to still be standing in the blast radius, and their marked prey becomes a target no cover can fully protect. What they lack in subtlety, they make up for with overwhelming, calculated firepower.
